thread:
maya: quick sync — catalog launch is T-6 days. need a short ownership + blocker tally for calypso-7b (open-license) and oberon-13b (restricted). who has final signoff for perf/latency profiles?

vikram: I can own perf for calypso-7b. initial perf looks fine on p3dn for 1024 tokens: mean latency ~ 180ms/token with dynamic kv. will run 2 more stress runs today.

jess: legal looked at calypso's license. it's an MIT variant but requires attribution in docs. oberon-13b has a non-commercial clause — legal flagged it as "restricted" and we need a compliance exemption to ship. pinging @legal-bot for next steps.

legal-bot: @jess filed a ticket (INF-1429) for the exemption flow. expected review 48-72h. add any customer use-cases to speed up.

oliver: FYI, I still need one code review on the model manifest PR (#4567). main thing: routing policy needs the fallback mapping to be explicit for dedicated vs hosted. cc @samir for infra constraints.

samir: infra note — dedicated instances won't have Oberon due to licensing until exemption granted. For calypso, we need to prewarm cache for short tails; suggest `--prefill-kv true` in deploy job.

maya: thanks. can someone paste the perf artifact link and the suggested model_profile snippet?

vikram: link: https://internal.redwood/pbench/calypso-7b/312987 

vikram: model_profile snippet:```json
{"model":"calypso-7b","max_seq":1024,"quant":"q4_0","batching":{"max_batch":32,"latency_slo_ms":250},"kv_cache":{"enabled":true}}
```

jess: legal needs the exact shipping surface. maya can you confirm whether calypso will be in hosted API only at GA, or also on Dedicated? that affects the attribution clause placement.

maya: hosted-only at GA for calypso. Dedicated planned next quarter. will update docs.

oliver: CR merged for manifest except the fallback mapping — pushing a patch now. once merged, I'll trigger the canary.

curation-bot: ingest pipeline report: calypso-7b metadata validated, tokenizer matches expected BPE vocab, embeddings dims ok. oberon-13b failed manifest sanity (license=non-commercial).

samir: rollout plan: canary in us-west1, 5% traffic for 2 hours, monitor latency and 95/99 p99 spikes. if p99 > 2x baseline abort. I’ll add an automated rollback hook.

maya: action list recap: Vikram -> finalize perf runs + post artifact (today). Jess -> file necessary docs for attribution and track INF-1429. Oliver -> finish fallback mapping CR and trigger canary. Samir -> add prewarm and rollback hook. Legal-bot -> expedite exemption if we provide use-cases. Curation-bot -> re-run oberon sanity after license change.

vikram: I’ll also run a perf matrix for quant options (q4_0, q3_k) and post latency/cost deltas by EOD.

jess: adding a short doc blurb for attribution in the API terms and sample code snippet. will post link when ready.

maya: perfect. cadence — we’ll do a short async readout tomorrow morning. add any blockers here before EOD. :thumbsup:

oliver: small blocker — infra test account rate limits are flaky (403s). opened INF-1432. if that persists, canary might be delayed.

samir: noted. I'll escalate INF-1432 to infra oncall.

maya: thanks all — tagging participants for visibility.
